primary_source.title: The trouble with the minimal renormalizable SO(10) GUT
primary_source.equation: Eq. (4), with completeness cross-check below Eqs. (3)-(7)
primary_source.source_statement: The complete renormalizable 126_H self-sector contains one quadratic norm, four hermitian quartic contractions with couplings lambda_0, lambda_2, lambda_4 and lambda_4_prime, plus one complex quartic structure with coupling eta_2 and its explicit conjugate. No cubic 126_H self-interaction appears in the complete potential.

epistemic_limit: This freezes only the sourced 126_H self-sector. It does not establish the complete FToE scalar action, vacuum, Hessian, heavy spectrum, thresholds, or publication readiness.
